Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exceptionally beautiful Chinese experiential website hero about Guardian Anarchy and 生生不息: fixed autonomous infrastructure supporting flourishing plural life, “trees are providers.”
Primary request: Create ONE original wide landscape image, 16:9, ideally 2560 pixels wide or higher. A sophisticated cinematic architectural editorial rendering of a far-future inhabited warm river valley in East/Southeast Asia. Quiet technologically abundant living future, not generic solarpunk decoration; infrastructure and future must be felt.
Scene and subject: Jade forest and water, a large mature tree by a shared stone terrace table, small people at ordinary activities. Exquisitely refined low glass, timber and ceramic pavilions and graceful narrow pedestrian links. Clearly visible working water channels and a shared fabrication pavilion. A small precision observatory among farther structures implies science beyond pastoral life.
Composition: Landscape has depth and believable human scale. Main human architecture and large mature tree concentrated middle/right. Left 38% is quieter shadowed valley, water and vegetation for separate HTML Chinese title. Meticulously composed, rich and immersive but with a clear focal hierarchy.
Lighting and materials: Sunlit clear dawn, atmospheric distant mountains, rich dark forest emeralds, celadon and small warm light. Beautiful natural material texture; inhabited architectural realism.
Constraints: No text, no logos, no UI. Not ink painting, not cartoon, not generic CGI blobs. No giant central tower, no AI brain, no humanoid robot hero, no floating islands, no fantasy impossible giant trees.

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: conceptual architectural cutaway for an exceptionally beautiful Chinese experiential website about Guardian Anarchy and 生生不息: fixed autonomous infrastructure supporting flourishing plural life, “trees are providers.”
Primary request: Create ONE original wide 3:2 image, ideally 2560 pixels wide or higher. Exquisite architectural axonometric cutaway of a slice of a small far-future inhabited warm river-valley settlement in East/Southeast Asia. Museum-quality educational architectural visualization, ultra detailed but composed. Same material world as refined low glass, timber and ceramic pavilions amid jade forest and water; infrastructure and future should be felt.
Composition: Floating presentation of a terrain-section model on a very pale ivory background, not a fantasy island. Main object occupies central 85% with breathing room.
Above ground: Central mature tree providing shade; small people around a shared long table. On the right a refined greenhouse/community workshop; on the left a rainwater receiving surface. Keep natural ecology visibly alive around infrastructure.
Below ground: An exposed terrain cross section clearly shows limited practical water reservoir chambers and pipes, an energy storage plant, repair/storage rooms, and a separated material reuse area. Soil, roots, and water paths must be legible; devices are practical, not magical.
Materials and color: Deep green canopy, warm wood and copper details, turquoise water, subdued realistic materials, exceptionally elegant architectural model rendering.
Constraints: This is conceptual illustration, not an engineering blueprint. No text, numbers, labels, leader lines, logos, or UI; webpage will provide semantic labels. No fantasy machines, no humanoid robot hero.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original two-panel diptych image for a Chinese experiential Guardian Anarchy website, showing broader futures of scientific inquiry and collective imagination beyond a pastoral valley.
Primary request: Create exactly ONE landscape image approximately 2:1, preferably high resolution 3072×1536 or higher if available. A diptych with TWO equal vertical panels side by side and a seamless hard vertical split precisely at 50%. No gap, no divider line, no frame. These equal halves will be shown separately in webpage interaction states, so each must be a coherent complete scene.
LEFT HALF: A visually stunning future open research and fabrication observatory hall. Humane warm timber and ceramic architecture with sophisticated precision robots working on a small interplanetary probe and large optical telescope components. Several ordinary people study the instruments together. An enormous window reveals bright sky and a green inhabited city. Clear advanced future technology, exacting instruments, visible scientific exploration and shared curiosity.
RIGHT HALF: A future shared immersive worldmaking hall in a dense vertical city. Beautiful pale structural ribs, clearly physical walkways and real handrails. People assemble a collective festival inside a full-scale spatial light and augmented reality environment. A luminous impossible sea-cloud landscape is projected over the clearly physical architecture. This is a full-body shared environment; no VR headsets. Make the distinction between actual structure and projected world legible.
Composition: Each half is a single coherent scene with its main people, devices, and visual action concentrated toward the right and bottom areas of that half. Leave quieter left portions of each half for separate HTML text overlays; do not put any text into the image.
Style: Museum-grade cinematic architectural photograph and concept visualization. Warm human wonder, adventurous abundance. Rich forest-green and copper material family alongside warm timber, fine ceramic, pale ribbed architecture and luminous daylight. Exquisitely detailed but refined and believable, distinctly futuristic, humane and inhabited.
Constraints: No typography, text, UI, labels, logos or watermarks. No neon or cyberpunk, no VR headsets, no spaceship bridge, no central AI icon, no AI brain. Hard split at image midpoint, two exactly equal panels. No extra panels.
